question: The decommissioned havelock bridge has been built over which of the following rivers?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Godavari.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Havelock Bridge** is another name for the **Old Godavari Bridge.**
 
• It is a **decommissioned bridge** that spans the **Godavari River in Andhra Pradesh, India.**
 
• The bridge was put into service in** 1900 **to accommodate** trains traveling between Howrah and Madras.**
 
• Of the three bridges that cross the** Godavari River in Rajahmundry,** this one is the oldest.
 
• Later, the **Godavari Arch Bridge** was built to replace the** Havelock Bridge.**
